facts.fact: 七月四日晚，Dr. Oppenheimer 罕见公开露面致词，并特别欢迎新成员——来自 Cambridge, Massachusetts 的 Dr. Randolph Horowitz 与他的女儿 Rachel。
facts.anchor: “Dr. Horowitz joins us from Cambridge, Massachusetts,” Dr. Oppenheimer said. “He’ll be helping see our projects here through to their final stages.”

facts.fact: 次日清晨，Willa Fischer 从丈夫 Elliot Fischer 的公文包前袋掉出的物件里瞥见一个从未见过的装置：薄的矩形塑料、像一本没有页的书、正面嵌有屏幕、几乎无重量。
facts.anchor: It was thin and rectangular, slim, shaped like a book without any pages. It was made of plastic, with a screen built into the front.

facts.fact: Willa 此后深夜偷看该装置的 PSA 视频；旁白（即怪兽片 Chimotera! 放映前战时新闻片的同一位解说员）说如今好点子来自 “a place called Public Access Afterworld”。
facts.anchor: We get them from a place deep underneath our own reality. From a place called Public Access Afterworld…”

facts.fact: 1945 年 7 月 16 日（周一）清晨 Trinity 核试验、天空 5:29 a.m. 亮起：Elliot Fischer 那天未到场而留在 Los Alamos 实验室工作；Los Alamos 的项目叫 Manhattan，他的项目叫 Chicago，距他“撕开历史”的时刻还有四天。
facts.anchor: Elliot Fischer wasn’t in attendance that morning at the Trinity test. He was back at Los Alamos, hard at work in his lab.

facts.fact: Rachel 转告父亲的警告：山上实验室在造比原子弹更大的东西，名叫 Chicago；一些科学家签了由总统办公室签署、具法律约束力的协议，把家中“不合群”的家人当试验品，战后丈夫将因此获得丰厚报酬。
facts.anchor: They call it Chicago. It’s something bigger. Even bigger than the bomb.

facts.fact: Willa 夜里经未上锁的服务门潜入实验室，发现 Elliot 桌上每个文件夹都手写标着 “CHICAGO”：内有纳粹影像、平板装置与脚下发光结构（“Conductor”）的蓝图，还有她自己一生的体检与分析师记录，抬头写着 “Willa Fischer. Subject.”——她确认自己就是实验对象。
facts.anchor: Her name was written at the top of each document. “Willa Fischer,” it said. “Subject.”

facts.fact: 黎明前 Willa 与 Rachel 在广场接吻时被 General Klein 撞见：Rachel 当场喊 “That’s disgusting! You’re crazy!” 撇清自保，Klein 拉起 Willa 的手把她送回家；随后 Elliot 松口，称她将去 “somewhere incredible”、要 “let me walk you there”，Willa 请求与小儿子 Marty 道别。
facts.anchor: “That’s disgusting! You’re crazy!” Rachel shouted. General Klein stepped between them like a referee. He made no big scene. He just took Willa by the hand.

facts.fact: Willa 与 Marty 道别后从屋后逃出营地、沿公路走了一整天；两个电流构成的人形拦路，次日晨两个 static men 站在十英尺外引路；她跟随他们走向沙漠中凭空成形的影像店 Captain Video（Marquee 拼出 “C…A…P…”），走进店内——门在身后关上、店面蒸发回虚无；科学家们正午前离开，试验成功。
facts.anchor: The little bell chimed once more as the door to the video store closed behind Willa. The storefront evaporated back into nothing, and soon the desert was calm once again.
